seoTitle: Link Your Bank Account or Card to eBay for Payouts
metaDescription: Learn how to add or update your bank account and card details on eBay so sellers get faster payouts and buyers get quicker checkouts.
intro: Whether you're selling and need reliable payouts or buying and want faster checkout, linking your bank account or card to eBay is a quick setup. This guide covers adding bank details through Seller Hub, verifying your account, and adding a card for purchases on the website or mobile app.

steps.heading: Open the Payments tab in Seller Hub
steps.body: Sellers can add or update bank details from the Payments section of eBay Seller Hub to set up automatic payouts.

steps.heading: Verify your bank account
steps.body: eBay requires verification of your bank details to ensure payouts are processed smoothly and without delays.

steps.heading: Choose your payout schedule
steps.body: Once verified, your account can receive payouts on a daily, weekly, or monthly basis depending on your preference.

steps.heading: Add a card for faster buyer checkout
steps.body: Buyers can add debit or credit card information in account settings to speed up checkout and set a preferred payment method.

steps.heading: Manage the setup on web or mobile
steps.body: These steps work whether you're using the eBay website or the mobile app, so your account stays ready either way.

steps.heading: Avoid common issues
steps.body: Double-check your details to avoid bank verification failures, and keep your card information current to prevent payout or checkout delays.

faq.question: Where do I add my bank account as an eBay seller?
faq.answer: You add and verify bank details through the Payments tab inside eBay Seller Hub.

faq.question: How often can I receive payouts?
faq.answer: You can typically choose to receive payouts on a daily, weekly, or monthly schedule once your bank is verified.

faq.question: Can I add a card just for buying on eBay?
faq.answer: Yes, buyers can add a debit or credit card in account settings to make checkout faster without setting up seller payouts.

faq.question: What if my bank verification fails?
faq.answer: Double-check that your account details match exactly what's on file with your bank, since mismatches are a common cause of verification failures.

faq.question: Can I remove an old card or bank account later?
faq.answer: Yes, old or expired payment methods can be removed and replaced in your eBay payment settings at any time.
